framework_contract.configuration: Pinned repository shared configuration; no deployment overrides that disable Hystrix or alter JSON/validation/security. Hystrix is on classpath, enabled=true, statistics client fallback is a component, no per-client vanilla Feign.Builder.

json.engine: Spring Boot default Jackson2 bean binding, with public source setters/getters invoked
json.unknown_properties: ignored by Boot default FAIL_ON_UNKNOWN_PROPERTIES=false; do not rely on the legacy org.codehaus.jackson annotation being recognized by Jackson2
json.null_inclusion: Default inclusion preserves null object properties
json.date_normalization: $instant means parse emitted ISO Date representation and require the exact instant, not any string, not arbitrary U. No claim of exact JSON byte formatting.
json.decimal_normalization: JSON numeric values compared as exact BigDecimal numeric values; nested DTO declared types are still required
json.projection_order: Property order is not specified; callback sets checked per trigger, not invented total getter order

framework_contract.binding_and_validation: Deserialize source bean first; field-based @Valid constraints then reject statistics incomes=null with MethodArgumentNotValidException/400 before handler. Binding callbacks still execute. Missing required RequestBody produces HttpMessageNotReadableException/400 before handler, with no DTO instance.
framework_contract.feign: POST/PUT request bodies use SpringEncoder; consumes APPLICATION_JSON_UTF8_VALUE yields application/json;charset=UTF-8. Default non-2xx error decoder throws. Hystrix statistics fallback returns normally; auth has no fallback and propagates failure (possibly wrapped).
framework_contract.events_and_edges: executes contains reached source methods, including public JSON callbacks and fallback. calls contains source-to-source method invocations; framework callback roots have trigger events, not fabricated caller->getter/setter calls. remote is added at entered remote handler, not request send; no statistics remote edge on binding validation reject. data is source method->logical collection and deduplicated within step.
framework_contract.persistence: Logical persistent Java fields, using declared field access. Mongo _id is Account.name or User.username. _class/internal BSON storage bytes are not the measured view. Each completed repository.save is an independent successful write; no source @Transactional spans the HTTP call.

provided_boundary.scope: The oracle starts after token verification at each incoming request boundary, including remote requests. Supplied Principal/OAuth2Request facts are checked as identity inputs. Source method-level scope decisions remain required. OAuth minting and CustomUserInfoTokenServices HTTP introspection are outside this business profile; the opaque strings below do not prove signature/token validity.

supplied-server-token.validation: already established input; no cryptographic verification claimed

supplied-user-token.available_at: step3 supplied post-auth boundary after user creation; issuance not analyzed

service-proof.source: cached OAuth2ClientContext supplied input for the source-defined client-credentials interceptor, not minted by analyzer

execution_environment.mongo_operations: successful acknowledged operations; no concurrent writers or exogenous persistence failures
execution_environment.http: healthy transport and source-selected service destinations; no timeout, service discovery failure, retries or open circuit preventing a declared request
execution_environment.hystrix_circuits: closed before selected requests; source server validation error is still an error and triggers the declared fallback
execution_environment.startup: complete before journey; no static/bean initialization is part of edge oracle

initial_state_recipe: Each case has its own full explicit initial_state and equal expected_state. Account seed fields come from the manually supplied additional v1 account context (20 USD and partially-known-seed), not from the final 20 EUR state of the main eight-step journey. Non-account tables use the explicit parent initial preconditions. The supplied authenticated context is a separate post-auth input, not an assertion that this fixture ran login.
